completePlan (full original text):
Create a clean, vertical flowchart diagram on a pure white background. The style should be schematic and educational, using high-contrast black outlines and sans-serif text.

**Layout & Nodes:**
1.  **Top Node (Start):** Draw a horizontally oriented oval (pill shape) with a black outline and white fill. Center the text "Start" inside in bold black font.
2.  **Second Node (Input):** Directly below "Start", draw a rectangle with sharp corners, black outline, and white fill. Center the text "Input". Connect "Start" to "Input" with a straight vertical arrow pointing down.
3.  **Third Node (Check):** Below "Input", draw a diamond shape (rhombus) with a black outline and white fill. Center the text "Check". Connect "Input" to "Check" with a straight vertical arrow pointing down.
4.  **Fourth Node (Output):** Below the "Check" diamond, draw a rectangle identical in style to the "Input" node. Center the text "Output". Connect the bottom tip of the "Check" diamond to the top of "Output" with a vertical arrow. Label this arrow segment "yes" (placed to the right of the line).
5.  **Bottom Node (End):** Below "Output", draw a horizontally oriented oval identical to the "Start" node. Center the text "End". Connect "Output" to "End" with a straight vertical arrow pointing down.

**Feedback Loop (No Path):**
*   Draw a return path for the negative condition. Start an arrow from the **left vertex** of the "Check" diamond.
*   Route the line horizontally to the left, then turn 90 degrees upwards, running parallel to the main vertical stack on the left side.
*   Turn 90 degrees right to merge into the vertical connector line between "Start" and "Input" (or point directly into the top of the "Input" box).
*   Add an arrowhead pointing towards the "Input" stage to indicate direction.
*   Label this returning path "no" (placed near the start of the line at the diamond or along the vertical rise).

**Visual Style Constraints:**
*   **Lines:** Uniform medium thickness (approx. 2pt) black lines for all shapes and arrows.
*   **Arrows:** Standard triangular arrowheads, filled black.
*   **Typography:** Simple, legible sans-serif font (e.g., Arial or Helvetica), black color, centered within shapes.
*   **Spacing:** Ensure equal vertical spacing between the main sequence nodes (Start, Input, Check, Output, End). Ensure sufficient horizontal space on the left for the feedback loop so lines do not overlap text.
